proposed_amendments_requiring_root_proto: TRAIN_SELECTION and DEV each contain 256 fresh independent acquisition parents (64 per family); the report does not specify these counts.
CHECK has 64 same-structure and 64 reserved-composition parents per family. Report both strata separately; new composition is not identical task difficulty.
Roles are assigned from the canonical latent-parent digest before rendering, target solving, model scoring or selection; all views of a parent inherit its role.
CHECK and FINAL structures are distinct catalogs; no CHECK/FINAL prompt, target or verifier payload is exported before its evaluation gate.
Retention DEV counts, eligible preservation sources and FINAL counts remain unresolved; no substitute retention bank is invented.
A five-role 70/8/8/8/6 percent hash allocator and separate structure eligibility are a proposed implementation policy, not a report-specified statistic.

parent_policy.assignment: sha256(domain separator + canonical semantic parent), first 64 bits modulo 10000
parent_policy.derivatives: All renderings, reordered irrelevant fields and local diagnostic mutations remain attached to the original parent; mutations are not independent evaluation units.
normalizations: finite-set sorting/deduplication and commutative query operands
symbolic variable indices independent of rendered names
text tokens and ordered transformation program

target_policy.envelope: one strict JSON object with exactly the answer key; no rationale
target_policy.text: exact transformed string with explicitly instructed separator
target_policy.verification: separate solver and verifier implementations; all positives plus malformed and wrong-answer controls; metadata errors fail as host errors

context_contract.truncation: forbidden; reject before final manifest freeze

retention_requirements: Training-safe replay must be disjoint from all scored preservation parents.
Fresh CHECK must not be a random re-split of an exposed historical bank.
Enroll actual base source-correct membership under frozen decoding; denominator zero is undefined.
Report retrieval, long-context, instruction following, language quality and abstention separately where represented; deterministic bridge tasks cannot establish all of these.
